subject: Billing onboarding: entity mapping, VAT & remittance details
messages:
From: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nitrocloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Billing onboarding for pilot — remit & VAT question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — team excited to move the pilot into procurement. Legal asked us to confirm how Redwood will invoice for the pilot. Two quick things they need confirmed before issuing a PO: 1) Which Redwood legal entity will issue invoices to NitroCloud EU? 2) Can you issue a single monthly invoice consolidated for our EU subsidiaries or do we need local invoices per country?

We intend to pay in EUR and will provide a standard PO if the invoice path is clear. Also confirm your standard net terms for pilot customers (we usually see Net30 or Net45).

Appreciate a quick read — procurement is targeting a PO this week.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Stone
Head of Cloud Partnerships
NitroCloud
procurement@nitrocloud.com

--
Attachment: NitroCloud_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nitrocloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Billing onboarding for pilot — remit & VAT question

Hi Evan — thanks, and glad the demo landed well. Looping in Kimberly (Billing Ops) and Monica (Sales Ops) to lock the commercial path. High-level answers up front:

- Redwood will invoice from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) or our EU subsidiary depending on the account entity we map for billing.
- We can support a single consolidated monthly invoice for NitroCloud provided you designate a single billing entity and provide EU VAT IDs for reverse-charge treatment where applicable.
- Standard pilot net terms are Net45; we can discuss Net30 for enterprise contracts.

Kimberly/Monica — can you confirm the required evidence for consolidated EU invoicing (VAT IDs, tax certificates) and whether we need local invoices per NitroCloud legal entity? Also confirm wiring details and whether we should expect a PO number on the invoice.

Next steps for procurement: if NitroCloud can provide the billing entity name, VAT ID(s) and intended remit entity, we will confirm invoice entity and share a sample AP-friendly invoice and wiring instructions.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Stone <evan.stone@nitrocloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing onboarding for pilot — remit & VAT question

Hi Evan — thanks for the SOW. Quick checklist we need from NitroCloud to issue correct invoices and enable reverse-charge where applicable: 

1) Billing entity legal name and address (the entity that will receive the invoice).
2) VAT ID(s) for each EU entity you want to consolidate under the single invoice. If one EU company will be the payor for all subsidiaries, provide that single VAT ID and confirmation of intercompany arrangements.
3) PO number (if procurement requires).
4) Supplier onboarding form filled (I can send a short form) — includes AP contact, remit method (wire/ACH), currency preference, and tax residency documents.

Proposed invoice flow options:
- Option A (preferred): Redwood EU subsidiary issues a consolidated monthly invoice in EUR to NitroCloud EU (reverse-charge applies if we receive valid VAT ID).
- Option B: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) invoices your US-payable entity in USD — this is less common for EU pilots.

Please note: if NitroCloud cannot provide a VAT ID for the billing entity, EU VAT will be charged on our invoice (we cannot apply reverse-charge without valid registration data).

Attachments: I can attach a sample invoice template and the supplier onboarding form.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement prefers to run through the fields.

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment stubs referenced: Redwood_SampleInvoice_EUR.pdf, Supplier_Onboarding_Form.docx

From: Maria Lopez <m.lopez@nitrocloud.es>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nitrocloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@nitrocloud.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 14:11:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Billing onboarding for pilot — remit & VAT question

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks for the clarity. NitroCloud will act through NitroCloud Europe SL (CIF B12345678) as the billing entity for the pilot. Attached is our EU VAT certificate for NitroCloud Europe SL. We prefer consolidated monthly billing in EUR and will provide a PO once we confirm the invoice party.

A few specifics from our tax team:
- We will use reverse-charge for Redwood EU invoices; please confirm the invoice line should reference "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive".
- Payment method: SEPA transfer to your account in EUR. Please share IBAN and SWIFT.
- Net terms: Procurement requests Net30 for the pilot. Is that acceptable?

Attached: NitroCloud_EU_VAT_Cert.pdf

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Tax & Treasury Manager
NitroCloud Europe SL
m.lopez@nitrocloud.es

--
Attachment: NitroCloud_EU_VAT_Cert.pdf (image/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <m.lopez@nitrocloud.es>, Evan Stone <evan.stone@nitrocloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 15:49:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Billing onboarding for pilot — remit & VAT question

Hi Maria — perfect, thanks for the certificate and clarity. Confirming next steps: 

1) Redwood will route the pilot invoice from Redwood Inference EU B.V. (our EU billing subsidiary) in EUR to NitroCloud Europe SL. We will include the line: "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive" when NitroCloud's VAT ID is present.

2) Net terms for this pilot approved at Net30 (as requested).

3) Kimberly will send the supplier onboarding form and a sample consolidated invoice template. Please return the completed form and PO number to procurement@redwoodinference.com.

4) Monica — can you prepare the billing account with SEPA instructions (IBAN + BIC) and confirm the invoice remittance email. Karthik — flag legal for a one-line MSA/order form redline: update the invoicing appendix to show EU subsidiary invoicing and Net30 for the pilot.

Evan/Maria — once we receive the completed onboarding form and PO we will kick billing and confirm the DocuSign SOW link for signature.

Thanks — welcome aboard.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

--
